core_obligations: Show that an effective relative r-cycle alpha is equidimensional (proof lines 1987-1992). By lemma-effective-support-closed (tag 0H5W) the support Supp(alpha) is closed in X (proof lines 1988-1989). By the definition of the support of a family (union over s of Supp(alpha_s) with Supp(alpha_s) contained in the fibre X_s), the fibre of Supp(alpha) over s is exactly Supp(alpha_s), the support of the cycle alpha_s in Z_r(X_s), which has dimension r (proof lines 1989-1991). Taking W = Supp(alpha), a closed subset of relative dimension r <= r over S containing the support, the definition of equidimensionality is satisfied (proof lines 1990-1991).
proof_roadmap: Closedness of the support from effectiveness (proof lines 1988-1989).
Fibres of the support are the fibre-cycle supports, of dimension r, by the definition of the family support (proof lines 1989-1991).
Conclude with W = Supp(alpha) in the equidimensionality definition (proof lines 1990-1991).
